headline: A 2017 executive order aimed at addressing violations and abuses of trade agreements the United States has with other countries.
what_it_does: Based on its title, this order directs the federal government to look at whether other countries are breaking or misusing trade agreements with the United States and to respond. No official summary was provided, so the specific steps, agencies, and deadlines are not described here.

who_it_affects.how: They would likely be the ones asked to identify and respond to trade agreement violations.
Their compliance with trade deals with the United States may come under review.
